name: atk vegetable pot pie
notes:
STUB — not yet captured or tested. Placeholder for America's Test Kitchen's vegetable pot pie recipe. Distinguishing features (from what I remember about the recipe): DARK VEGETABLE BROTH and TURNIPS as the load-bearing components — the dark-broth approach is what makes it work in the pastry-pie format where a lighter vegetable stew would read too soupy under the crust.

Why this recipe belongs in the cookbook: it's the target destination when the hearty-beef-flavored-pie craving hits — french-beef-and-mushroom-stew explicitly doesn't pot-pie well (see that recipe's DOESN'T WORK IN A POT PIE note), and this ATK approach is what should work instead. Second option is lentil-wellington, but that's a different format (log-wrapped-in-puff-pastry rather than pie).
